output.review_comment: Approving; I couldn't see or run the tests, so please confirm CI passes before merging. The change applies general title-case rules: (1) any word with a capital letter after its first character (e.g. "iPhone", "NASA") keeps its casing, where the old code turned "iPhone" into "Iphone"; (2) small words stay lowercase unless they come first, come last, or follow a word ending in ':'; (3) all other words are capitalized. Nothing is hardcoded for particular test inputs, and the tests are unchanged as requested. Suggestions, none blocking: the colon check misses a colon followed by a quote or bracket (e.g. ':"'); double spaces produce empty words, which the code handles safely but which affect first/after-colon detection; hyphenated words aren't handled. Please also ask for a PR description that lists these rules and the failing tests they fix, so the editorial team can check it against the agreed spec.
